title: Detailed pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Scissors, detailed, bright and clear on dark screen -->
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points="18,22 50,48 47,53 14,27" fill="#a8d8ff" stroke="#d0ecff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points="82,22 50,48 53,53 86,27" fill="#7fc4ff" stroke="#b0dcff" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Left blade edge highlight -->
  <line x1="20" y1="24" x2="49" y2="49" stroke="#e8f6ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Right blade edge highlight -->
  <line x1="80" y1="24" x2="51" y2="49" stroke="#d8f0ff" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="49" r="4.5" fill="#ffd94a" stroke="#ffe680" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="49" r="2" fill="#ff9f1c"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="49" r="0.8" fill="#fff3c4"/>
  
  <!-- Left handle (below pivot) -->
  <!-- Handle arm -->
  <path d="M 50,53 Q 42,64 34,74" fill="none" stroke="#ff7b54" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left finger ring -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="82" rx="10" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#ff5c33" stroke-width="4"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="82" rx="10" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#ff8c66" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Right handle (below pivot) -->
  <!-- Handle arm -->
  <path d="M 50,53 Q 58,64 66,74" fill="none" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right finger ring -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="82" rx="10" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#ff9f1c" stroke-width="4"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="82" rx="10" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#ffd180" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Blade tips detail -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#e8f6ff"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#d8f0ff"/>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="38" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
